headline: Brazil MSCI ETF and ADR index drop over 2% to 3% tracking US market slump
summary: The iShares MSCI Brazil ETF (EWZ) tumbled over 3% in New York while domestic exchanges were closed for a holiday, with US-listed Brazilian ADRs falling more than 2% in sympathy with broader US tech-led declines.
why: Brazilian ADRs and country ETFs serve as real-time liquid proxies for Latin American risk when domestic exchanges in São Paulo are closed.

impacts.name: iShares MSCI Brazil ETF
impacts.why: The Brazil ETF fell more than 3% as global risk appetite dropped while local markets were shut.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A heavy sell-off in US equity benchmarks triggered sharp risk-off outflows from emerging market assets, pulling down US-traded Brazilian shares.
